capabilities: create one note per table with columns as col_* properties
render an interactive ER diagram with pan, zoom and drag
navigate from diagram clicks to table notes and column headings
mark invalid columns and broken references with inline feedback
update all references when a table is renamed
extras: Full documentation lives in an external user guide, developer guide and a separate PROJECT.md specification; installable via BRAT or manual download, and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to document database table schemas in notes or visualize their relations as an ER diagram.
summary: Documents database schemas as one note per table, with columns as properties, and renders them as an interactive, clickable ER diagram.
